Container.Name: Scan2Target
Container.Overview: Web-based scan server for USB and network scanners. Scan2Target discovers scanners and routes documents to file shares, mail, Paperless-ngx, webhooks and cloud providers.
Container.Requires: Scanner discovery uses mDNS/AirScan, which only reaches devices in the same broadcast domain. Host networking is the simplest way to get that, and it also lets the container deliver to shares on this server. A custom network such as br0 or br0.20 works as well, as long as three things hold: the scanners sit in that same VLAN, the Docker custom network type is macvlan and not ipvlan (ipvlan does not pass mDNS), and "Host access to custom networks" is enabled if you deliver to a share on this server. Host networking also binds port 8000 on the server itself, so a custom network is the way out of a port conflict. USB scanners additionally require access to /dev/bus/usb.

Config.Name: Data Volume
Config.Description: Persistent database, configuration and scanned files.

Config.Name: USB Devices
Config.Description: USB device access for locally attached scanners.

Config.Name: Log Volume
Config.Description: Persistent log directory. Without it the logs live inside the container and are lost whenever it is recreated.

Config.Name: SCAN2TARGET_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Encryption key for stored credentials; generate with openssl rand -base64 32.

Config.Name: SCAN2TARGET_JWT_SECRET
Config.Description: Signing key for session tokens; generate with openssl rand -base64 32. Leave empty to use the application default.

Config.Name: SCAN2TARGET_HA_API_KEY
Config.Description: Long-lived access token for the Home Assistant integration. Leave empty to disable it.

Config.Name: SCAN2TARGET_ALLOW_PRIVATE_WEBHOOKS
Config.Description: Allow webhook delivery to private and local addresses. Needed to reach services on your own network; it also removes a safeguard against requests to internal hosts.

Config.Name: SCAN2TARGET_CORS_ORIGINS
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of origins allowed to call the API from a browser. Leave empty unless another web application embeds this one.
